summary: Comprehensive testing of NoteAll Product Presentation features: theme selector for PDF download and /product-short route. All 13 test cases passed. Both routes load correctly with proper slide counts (14 for /product, 13 for /product-short). Theme dropdown with Light/Dark options works on both routes. Navigation (arrows, keyboard, dots) works correctly. Slide numbering is correct (12/14 on /product, 12/13 on /product-short). Slide 13 (Механики продвижения) is correctly excluded from /product-short. All text in Russian as expected.

minor_warnings.issue: Console shows 'Buffer is not defined' errors during PDF pre-generation
minor_warnings.note: Known issue with @react-pdf/renderer v4.x in browser environments. PDFs still generate correctly. Non-blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: NoteAll Product Presentation at /product and /product-short fully tested. Key findings: (1) /product has 14 slides, /product-short has 13 slides (excludes NPSlide13Growth), (2) PDF button shows loading spinner during pre-generation (~2-3 seconds), then becomes enabled, (3) Clicking PDF button shows dropdown with 'Светлая тема' (Light) and 'Тёмная тема' (Dark) options, (4) Both PDFs are pre-generated on page load using preGenerateNoteAllProductPdfs(), (5) Download uses blob URLs via downloadBlob() function, (6) data-testid attributes: 'np-presentation' (container), 'np-pdf-btn' (PDF button), 'np-theme-menu' (dropdown), 'np-pdf-light'/'np-pdf-dark' (theme options), 'np-dot-{0-13}' (navigation dots), 'np-prev-btn'/'np-next-btn' (navigation arrows), 'np-growth-title' (slide 13 title), (7) SlideTotal React context provides correct total to NPSlideContainer for dynamic numbering, (8) Dropdown closes on outside click, (9) Keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight) works, (10) All text in Russian.
